definitions.explanation: The process of reducing temperature, often used in technical or industrial contexts.

examples.japanese: {冷却|れいきゃく}⟦{装置|そうち}→装置：03318_souchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
{冷却|れいきゃく}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧。

notes:
{冷却|れいきゃく} combines {冷|れい} (cold) + {却|きゃく} (withdraw), referring to the process of reducing temperature. Primarily a technical/scientific term.

USAGE:
Most common in technical and industrial contexts. Also used figuratively: {冷却|れいきゃく}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧ means a "cooling-off period" for emotions or negotiations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冷却|れいきゃく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to cool
- {冷却|れいきゃく}⟦{装置|そうち}→装置：03318_souchi⟧: cooling system/device
- {冷却|れいきゃく}{水|すい}: coolant water
- {冷却|れいきゃく}⟦{期間|きかん}→期間：00229_kikan⟧: cooling-off period
- {冷却|れいきゃく}ファン: cooling fan

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{冷|ひ}やす→冷やす：02403_hiyasu⟧: to cool (everyday, e.g. food/drinks)
- ⟦{冷凍|れいとう}→冷凍：11730_reitou⟧: freezing (below 0°C)
- ⟦{冷蔵|れいぞう}→冷蔵：11731_reizou⟧: refrigeration (above 0°C)
- ⟦{加熱|かねつ}→加熱：00168_kanetsu⟧: heating (opposite process)
